mapper.select: SELECT revision, aliases_json, tags_json, favorite, main_note_id, visited_at FROM knowledge_organization WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND item_id = #{id}
SELECT id, note_id FROM knowledge_concept_note WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND concept_id = #{id} ORDER BY id LIMIT 101
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_organization SET visited_at = #{now} WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND item_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_concept_note (id, owner_id, concept_id, note_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, #{conceptId}, #{noteId}, #{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_concept_note WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id, i.kind, v.title, i.status, i.metadata_revision, i.version_number, i.updated_at, o.visited_at FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.id = i.current_version_id AND v.item_id = i.id AND v.owner_id = i.owner_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_organization o ON o.item_id = i.id AND o.owner_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.owner_id = #{owner} AND i.status = #{status} AND i.kind = #{kind} AND v.title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' AND o.favorite = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item_topic t WHERE t.item_id = i.id)
AND o.visited_at IS NOT NULL AND (o.visited_at < #{cursorTime} OR (o.visited_at = #{cursorTime} AND i.id > #{cursorId})) ORDER BY o.visited_at DESC, i.id
AND i.id > #{cursorId}ORDER BY i.id
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM knowledge_item WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id IN #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_reference_scan WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND version_id = #{versionId})
